sched.title: Schedule
sched.body: Two scans per US equity session: mid-morning (10:30 ET) and afternoon (15:30 ET). Outside regular hours the cycle is a no-op. Afternoon is catch-up for tickers that turn red later in the day.

funds.title: Fund universe
funds.body: Fixed ETF list in three sleeves — core (~50%), dividend (~25%), growth (~25%). Primaries are VOO, SCHD, and QQQM; alternates are documented for research but buys prefer the primary when it is red.

aMD.title: Alpaca market data
aMD.body: For each listed ticker, prior daily close versus last trade/price to compute that fund’s own day return. No SPY-only gate.

aTR.title: Alpaca trading API
aTR.body: Live equity, cash, and positions to measure sleeve weights against targets before sizing a buy.

red.title: Per-ticker red check
red.body: Rule A: a fund is eligible only when its own day return is negative. Green tickers are skipped — no model, no regime pre-brain.

sleeve.title: Sleeve underweight
sleeve.body: Map holdings into core / dividend / growth. Buy only into sleeves below target. Prefer the sleeve primary if it is red; else the first red alternate.

dedupe.title: Same-day dedupe
dedupe.body: If that sleeve (or symbol) already received a placed buy today, afternoon skips it. Prevents doubling up across the two scans.

buy.title: Market buy
buy.body: Notional market order sized as a fraction of equity (default 5%), cash-capped. No auto-sell in v2 — buy and hold.

hold.title: Skip / HOLD
hold.body: Green day, sleeve already at target, or already bought today → journal a HOLD rationale and move on.

alp.title: Alpaca paper
alp.body: Paper brokerage book is the scoreboard. Same account carries forward; no need for an LLM budget.

db.title: SQLite journal
db.body: Every decision lands as a row: action, rationale, execute status, optional order id.

jsl.title: JSONL mirror
jsl.body: Append-only text mirror of journal rows for easy grepping and offline analysis.

web.title: Operator dashboard
web.body: Private FastAPI viewer for cycles and positions. Not exposed on this public site.
